stickyNotes.content:
## Setup: Slack channel and time zone

1. Add your Slack connection to **Send good morning message**, then pick the **Channel ID**. Invite the ByteChef Slack app to that channel first.
2. Set **Timezone** in **Every weekday at 9:00** to your team's time zone. It ships as UTC.
3. Change **Hour**, **Days of Week** or the message text if you like.
4. Click **Test** to post the message once, then deploy the workflow to run it every weekday.
